heroSub: Tailor-made logistics services from Europe to Africa by road, air, water or rail – we deliver your cargo safely to its destination with efficiency and care

stats.label: Point of contact for your shipment

introTitle: A Berlin logistics partner for two continents.
introP1: DEExpress coordinates air, sea and vehicle shipping from Europe to destinations across 26 African countries and the Middle East —
introP2: helping individuals and businesses move internationally with greater clarity and control.
servicesTitle: One partner. Every mode of transport.
servicesSub: From time-critical air freight to cost-efficient sea freight, vehicles, commercial cargo and secure storage — choose the service, we plan the route.
coverageSub: Our network connects European origins with destinations across Africa and the Middle East. Select a region to see how we move your freight.
whyTitle: Built on speed, transparency and trust.

why.title: Speed
why.text: We are fast and effective — from the first inquiry to the final delivery of your cargo.

why.title: Tracking
why.text: Up-to-date status details for your customers, from the point of shipment until arrival.

why.title: Flexible payment
why.text: Payment should not be a barrier. Contact us — we will find an option that works for you.

why.title: Service
why.text: A customer service team that is ready to assist quickly, in English, German or French.

processSub: A simple, transparent process — the same for a single box or a full commercial load.

steps.title: Contact us
steps.text: Tell us what you are shipping — by form, phone or WhatsApp.

steps.title: Get a free estimate
steps.text: We review your requirement and send you a free, no-obligation offer.

steps.title: Packing
steps.text: You prepare your cargo for shipment or storage — we advise you on how.

steps.title: Collection & shipping
steps.text: Within Berlin we collect your cargo. From there, we coordinate the journey to its destination.

trackingSub: Enter your reference and see the latest available status — from booking to arrival.
industriesSub: Different cargo, different requirements — the same dependable handling.

industries.title: Automotive
industries.text: Ensure your tracking number to see the latest status and estimated delivery date.

industries.title: Retail
industries.text: Fast and reliable delivery of consumer goods to stores and customers.

industries.title: Food
industries.text: Temperature-controlled logistics for perishable goods and ingredients.

industries.title: Hardware
industries.text: Specialized handling for heavy machinery and sensitive electronic equipment.

sourcingTitle: Looking for a vehicle in Europe?
sourcingText: We find, inspect and purchase vehicles on your behalf — then connect the process directly to international vehicle shipping. One team, one contact, from search to delivery.
ctaText: Tell us what you are shipping and where it needs to go — we will send you a free, no-obligation estimate.

preference.title: Ship your preference
preference.text: From origin to destination, we follow your preference in means, cost and handling.

stats.label: Destinations across Africa & the Middle East

testimonial.quote: "DEexpress transformed our supply chain. Their real-time tracking and dedicated team reduced our transit times by 40% on the Berlin-Lagos corridor."
testimonial.name: Marcus Weber
